title: Literature Reviewing
intent: formative · Research & Retrieval (Doing) · click through the process
statement: Go beyond listing sources: synthesise them, map what is known, and find the gap your work will fill.

steps.title: Gather the key works
steps.text: Collect the sources that actually shape the conversation, not everything you can find.

steps.title: Group by theme or position
steps.text: Cluster sources by what they argue or find, so the field has a shape.

steps.title: Synthesise across them
steps.text: Write about the debate, not source-by-source — where they agree, clash and build.

steps.title: Find the gap
steps.text: Name the question the literature has not yet answered. That gap is your opening.

steps.title: Place your work in the lineage
steps.text: Show how your study follows from, and adds to, what came before.

feedForward.text: For five sources on your topic, write one sentence that groups three of them and names the gap the other two leave.
